item.title: Solved: How to Identify Repeating 3-Digit Numbers in a String of a Million Digits
item.description: In a recent interview with a hedge fund in New York, I faced a challenging question that left a lasting impact on my coding journey. The task was to develop a function in Python that analyzes a string containing a million digits and returns all repeating 3-digit sequences along with their frequency of occurrence. The task sounded simple at first, but it raised intriguing questions about algorithm complexity and data processing.
